mapper.sql: direction_basis_cd <> 'MANUAL' AND ( direction_basis_cd <> 'DEM' OR fwd_uphill_yn IS NULL OR fwd_ascent_m IS NULL OR fwd_descent_m IS NULL )
mapper.select: WITH candidate AS ( SELECT edge_id, geom, GREATEST( 1, CEIL(ST_Length(geom) / CAST(#{sampleIntervalM} AS numeric))::integer ) AS segment_count FROM public.trail_edge WHERE AND ST_SRID(geom) = 5179 AND GeometryType(geom) = 'LINESTRING' AND ST_NDims(geom) = 2 AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom) AND ST_IsValid(geom) AND ST_Length(geom) > 0 ), sample AS ( SELECT candidate.edge_id, candidate.geom, candidate.segment_count, generate_series(0, candidate.segment_count) AS sample_index FROM candidate ), point AS ( SELECT edge_id, sample_index + 1 AS seq_no, ST_Transform( CASE WHEN sample_index = 0 THEN ST_StartPoint(geom) WHEN sample_index = segment_count THEN ST_EndPoint(geom) ELSE ST_LineInterpolatePoint( geom, sample_index::double precision / segment_count::double precision ) END, 4326 ) AS geom FROM sample ) SELECT edge_id, seq_no, ST_X(geom) AS longitude, ST_Y(geom) AS latitude FROM point ORDER BY edge_id, seq_no
